description: Zeke's Landing and Marina sits just across the street from some of the most beautiful beaches in the country. A mere 10-minute boat ride from the Gulf of Mexico. Zeke's boasts a long history of excellence in the charter fishing industry and proudly hosts the largest charter fleet on the Gulf. For your next saltwater fishing adventure, consider Zeke's Marina. We offer the largest charter fleet on Alabama's Gulf Coast, providing the perfect trip for every angler, regardless of experience level. Additionally, we offer a variety of dry dock options. Our commitment extends to providing premier customer service and adopting an environmentally friendly approach to operating a marina.

Zeke's Landing and Marina. Fishing Charters & Cruises in Orange Beach, AL. We're Open 7 Days a Week and Fish Year Round! Orange Beach Fishing Charters. Offshore Fishing Private Charters - We offer the largest charter fishing fleet on the island and with over 50 boats in our fleet, you're sure to find the perfect fishing trip for you and your family! Target larger fish than what's available inshore on our offshore private charters. Inshore Fishing Private Charters - Inshore fishing takes place in the serene back bay areas and close to the picturesque shoreline. Inshore fishing is especially ideal for families with small children or those prone to sea sickness, providing a smooth and enjoyable experience.
